instance_features.basis_convention: FCIDUMPs are direct conversions of Goings et al. HDF5 active-space tensors; ECORE is the source HDF5 ecore and active orbitals are localized high-spin ROHF orbitals.
instance_features.family: P450 Goings Cpd I oxo high-spin active spaces

references: P450 Spin-5/2 DMRG fitted-energy table supplied by the paper authors to Matt Otten, private communication, 2026-07-09.

features.basis_set: cc-pVDZ active-space Hamiltonian from Goings et al. source archive
features.orbital_basis: localized high-spin ROHF active-space orbitals from the Goings et al. P450 source package
features.software_used: Goings et al. Zenodo HDF5 active-space tensors converted to FCIDUMP with PySCF

independent_parameters.molecule: cytochrome P450 Compound I oxo model

requirements.reference_energy_method: DMRG finite-M bond-dimension ladder with second-order polynomial extrapolation in 1/M
requirements.reference_energy_note: Spin-5/2 active-space C uses M ladder 512.0;1024.0;2048.0;3072.0;4096.0 with energies -2756.511360000000;-2756.511360000000;-2756.511360000000;-2756.511360000000;-2756.511360000000 Ha. Extrapolated reference is -2756.511360000000 Ha; largest-M(4096.0) energy is -2756.511360000000 Ha; fit-minus-largest-M is -4.547e-13 Ha and max fit residual is 2.274e-12 Ha. The author-supplied file states the fitted energies use only a second-order polynomial and not the truncation error.
requirements.reference_energy_source: author-supplied fitted DMRG M-ladder values from paper authors to Matt Otten, private communication; mapped to emitted FCIDUMP checksum from analysis/p450_goings_active_spaces/p450_g9_reference_mapping.csv.
